actual_request.prompt:
Create ONE independently articulated full-body game animation sprite, native square at least 1024x1024, genuine transparent alpha. No sprite sheet.
Image1 is PRIMARY CAMERA, PROPORTION AND MATERIAL reference: preserve this exact rear-left three-quarter character. She faces TOP LEFT; we see back and left shoulder, tiny cheek silhouette, NO EYE. Fixed crown, hair, sleeves, arm positions and equipment scale. Only independently articulate the new walk phase and small cloth response. Image2 is original identity: same rounded chibi star formation girl, dark brown straight hair, high bun/star crown, black/ivory/red/gold robe, short ivory trousers, black-gold boots; RIGHT hand star astrolabe and LEFT hand exactly three black-gold cards. Image3 is approved PRIMARY PAINTING STYLE, refined clean bright hand-painted Daoist chibi, no UI.
One calm WALK phase 09/16: RIGHT heel contacts in front, LEFT foot remains behind pushing off through the toe. Both feet have ground contact. Right stride is forward along the heading; left stride is backward. Opposite contact extreme to frame01.
Critical anatomy and visible placement: Opposite contact from image source NW01: far RIGHT boot is AHEAD upper-left, heel touching ground. Near LEFT boot is BEHIND lower-right pushing through toes. Never show left boot ahead here.
Both toes point upper-left with fixed rear-left perspective. Anatomical LEFT leg is the near leg and crosses visually in front of the far RIGHT leg only through natural occlusion. Feet move separately along parallel trajectories; no crossing knees, no leg identity swap, no jump or run. At least one sole or toe bears weight throughout. Draw a real new gait pose, no copying, mirror, warp, interpolation, or translation of the reference.
Keep full figure and equipment inside clear margins. Fixed body axis x512, grounded support sole baseline about y942, crown top about y65 proportional to 1024. Same scale as image1. Ground plane perspective allows the more distant advancing foot to appear slightly higher. Body stays upright, no camera or zoom change. Keep short limbs readable below robe.
TRUE alpha transparency, no ground shadow, no floor, no checkerboard, no halo, no detached effects, no text. Opaque skin and ivory fabric with clean edges. Highest finish supported by host.
